name: incident-response-runbook
description: Run and document production incidents — severity classification, incident commander role, communication cadence, triage steps, post-incident review (PIR/postmortem) generation, and action item tracking. Use when asked about "incident response", "how to run an incident", "postmortem template", "PIR", "on-call runbook", "severity levels", or when a production issue is actively happening. Do NOT use for: SLO target design — use `slo-design`.
